title: Earn with RapidBill
sub: Tell fellow shopkeepers about RapidBill. Earn {{percent}}% every time they pay.

credits.label: Your credits
credits.onHold: {{amount}} is kept aside for a payment in progress.
credits.note: Credits are not cash. They pay for your own plan or renewal, and they never expire.

code.label: Your referral code
code.messageHint: You can change the message before you share it.
code.copyFailed: Could not copy. Please select the text and copy it.

shareText: Hi! I use RapidBill for GST billing and stock in my shop. It works even without internet. Try it free for 15 days with my code {{code}}: {{link}}

s1.d: Send it to a fellow shopkeeper.

s2.d: They sign up with your code and pay for any plan.

s3.d: You get {{percent}}% of their plan fee as credits. And you earn again every time they renew.

people.title: People you referred
people.emptyTitle: No one has signed up with your code yet
people.emptyBody: Share your code with a fellow shopkeeper. For example, if a friend buys Mobile + Web for {{price}}, you earn {{reward}}. When they renew next year, you earn again.

locked.title: Buy a plan to start earning
locked.body: Once you are on a paid plan, you get your own referral code. Share it with fellow business owners and earn {{percent}}% of their plan fee, again every time they renew.
locked.codeHidden: Your code will appear here once you buy a plan.
locked.endedTitle: Renew your plan to keep earning
locked.endedBody: Your plan has ended, so your code is hidden and new rewards are paused. Your credits are safe. Use them when you renew.

newReward: 🎉 You earned {{amount}} since you last looked. Keep sharing!
